name: Development Code Fragment
description: Fragments used only during development, such as var_dump() and print_r(), left behind in the code.

name: Goto Statement
description: Use of the goto statement, which makes the program flow hard to follow.

name: Implicitly Granted Privileges
description: A privilege implicitly granted along with another: routines protected by one privilege perform operations that would require another, without checking it.

name: Semantically Related Privileges
description: Privileges with the same semantics duplicated for each component of the system, which couples privileges to components.

name: Embedded/Inline JavaScript
description: JavaScript in the generated HTML, in <script> tags or in element attributes, mixing logic and presentation.

name: Embedded/Inline CSS
description: CSS in the generated HTML, in <style> tags or in the style attribute, instead of separate style sheets.

name: CSS in JavaScript
description: Style properties defined in JavaScript code, including through jQuery.

name: Scattered Sources
description: Related fragments of client-side code spread across different functions of the server-side code.

name: Duplicate JS
description: Repeated JavaScript fragments embedded in the server-side code.

name: HTML Syntax Error
description: Generated HTML that does not conform to the language specification, such as unclosed tags.

name: Excessive Class Length
description: Class with too much code (e.g., more than 1,000 lines), which indicates too many responsibilities.

name: Excessive Method Length
description: Method that is too long (e.g., more than 100 lines), hard to understand and maintain.

name: Excessive Parameter List
description: Method with too many parameters (e.g., more than 10), a sign that it accumulates tasks.

name: Too Many Methods
description: Class with too many methods (e.g., more than 25), which indicates low cohesion.

name: Too Many Public Methods
description: Class with too many public methods (e.g., more than 10), exposing too much functionality.

name: Too Many Fields
description: Class with too many fields (e.g., more than 15).

name: Excessive Public Count
description: Class with too many public methods and attributes combined (e.g., more than 45).

name: Cyclomatic Complexity
description: Too many decision points in a method (e.g., complexity above 10).

name: NPath Complexity
description: Too many acyclic execution paths in a method (e.g., more than 200).

name: Excessive Class Complexity
description: Excessive sum of the complexities of the methods of a class (e.g., above 50).

name: Coupling Between Objects
description: Class with too many dependencies (e.g., more than 13), which propagates the effect of changes.

name: Depth of Inheritance
description: Inheritance hierarchy that is too deep (e.g., more than 6 levels).

name: Number of Children
description: Class with too many subclasses (e.g., more than 15).

name: Duplicate Code
description: Repeated code fragments in different parts of the system.

name: Unused Private Field
description: Private field that is never used.

name: Unused Private Method
description: Private method that is never called.

name: Unused Local Variable
description: Local variable that is declared and never used.

name: Unused Formal Parameter
description: Method parameter that is never used in the method body.

name: Empty Catch Block
description: Empty catch block, which ignores the caught exception.

name: Missing Function Comments
description: Functions without documentation comments.

name: Missing @Return Tag in Comments
description: Function comments without the description of the return value (@return).

name: Poorly Grouped Parameter Tags
description: Parameter tags poorly grouped in documentation comments.

name: Comment Style (/**)
description: Comments that do not follow the required documentation style (/**).

name: Missing Parameter Name
description: @param tag without the parameter name in documentation comments.

name: Brace Placement Rules
description: Braces placed outside the coding standard, such as an opening brace that should be on a new line.

name: Incorrect Spacing After Commas
description: Missing space after commas.

name: Functions Parentheses on Multiple Lines
description: Improper use of parentheses in multi-line function calls.

name: Blank Line Before Tags
description: Incorrect number of blank lines before the tags in documentation comments.
